title: Gali le Iskawut
intro: Inki numih doolat, silaytu, maqna sinni ginoona, kee qaran ginoona, inki qunxaaneyti kee sissik adoytit rankoh addat yewqeh yan — dubuk baxsa le agattiinah qadar wagsiisak yewqeh yan revelations luk yewqeh. ta intiita le xaagi numma ifuh baahe iggima ramid elle beyte aracal. Anu miyyaay?
clues: Anu cokmi buxal ayfaf eceeh, sinam, ambulle wayta gino, kee qaran gineenit inkih tan cogdah yan miraacah raddi elle yeceen, kaxxa caacay amriseh.
Anu inni postik raaqeh suge udduruh, kee amoyti bakcarra xagniseh sugem anu ruffa hayta sabab xayyoysam duude week.
Anu qunxa haadiyya gino kinniyo, af le mablal tamixxigeeh, yi qaynat massakaxxa luk suge saanih migaq luk sugeh yan revelation galitteh addal.
Anu adaare waqdi xer baaxoh xaagu baahe ummatta ayroytal sujuudul inti maleelah qaran kee baax gineh yan numuk.
Anu kaxxa amoytiinul miraacissa barra gee, qaxmeqe taaqel daffeyak, dumal numma qigdu aaxaguk masuginna.
Anu Saba'h doolat geeh yan numuy, silaytut reeda akah yeceenih yanin nabiyyi-amoytak arciba ayyufta quukak suge numu.

arabic: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
